field.label: Enable Frontend UI
field.comment: Controls the custom search overlay, category page, and product sliders. Disable to fall back to Luma's native search and category layout.

field.label: Enable Real-Time Sync
field.comment: When enabled, product saves and stock changes are synced immediately. When disabled, only the cron sync runs.

field.label: Enable Shadow DOM Widget (Beta)
field.comment: Rollout-only switch for the new Shadow DOM-isolated widget, replacing the legacy overlay/PLP templates one screen at a time. Independent of "Enable Frontend UI" above — collapses back into a single flag once the migration is complete.

field.label: Enable SSR Shell for Category Pages (Beta)
field.comment: Renders a real, crawlable product grid server-side (from Magento's own catalog data, not a live platform call) inside a Declarative Shadow DOM shell, which the widget then enhances in place once its JS loads. Only takes effect when the Shadow DOM Widget above is also enabled.

field.label: Enable Category Page Enhancement (Beta)
field.comment: Fail-open, deliberately the opposite of the search widget's behavior: FalcoSense's ranked results and filters only replace the native grid once real data has actually arrived. On any failure, the native category grid is left completely untouched — category/PLP browsing must never depend on FalcoSense's uptime.

field.label: Native Category Grid Selector
field.comment: CSS selector for the native product grid to hide once FalcoSense's enhanced grid is ready. Unlike the search input, there is no single selector guaranteed across every theme — verify this against the actual theme before relying on it. Default targets Luma-family themes.

field.label: Widget Accent Color Override
field.comment: Optional CSS color (e.g. #1565c0). Leave blank to auto-detect from the theme's own primary button color at runtime. Only needed if auto-detection picks the wrong color for a particular theme.

field.label: Platform Endpoint URL
field.comment: e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8080/api/v1/ingest/products

field.label: API Key
field.comment: X-Api-Key sent to the platform with every ingest request

field.label: Search API URL
field.comment: e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8001/api/search.php

field.label: Platform Store / Tenant ID
field.comment: The platform-side store id this Magento store view maps to. Set this per store view. Leave 0 to fall back to a position-derived id, which can shift if store views are added or removed.

field.label: Products Per Page
field.comment: Number of products shown per page on category and search results. Use a multiple of 6 (e.g. 12, 18, 24) to avoid orphaned products in the grid.

group.label: Category & Search SSR (ISR)
group.comment: Server-renders category and search listings from the platform (one source, no DB/index drift), cached and refreshed ISR-style. Requires "Enable Frontend UI".

field.label: Enable Platform SSR for Listings
field.comment: When on, category/search pages render their product grid + JSON-LD server-side from the platform's own response. When off, or when the platform has no data, the native Magento grid renders unchanged.

field.label: Snapshot TTL (seconds)
field.comment: How long a cached platform response is served before the next render refreshes it. Event-driven purge on product change happens regardless of this value. 300-900 is the sane range.

field.label: Platform Render Timeout (ms)
field.comment: Hard budget for the server-side platform call during page render. Exceeded = abandon and serve the last-known-good snapshot, then the native grid. Keep low (300-800).

field.label: Minimum Sync Coverage Ratio
field.comment: Safety guard for partially-synced catalogs: if the platform returns fewer than this fraction of a category's product count (e.g. 0.5), render the native grid instead. 0 disables the guard.

field.label: Pre-warm Popular Categories
field.comment: A cron pre-fetches the top categories' snapshots every few minutes so even the first visitor after a TTL expiry gets an instant cache hit. Adds a small steady load on the platform.

field.label: Categories to Pre-warm
field.comment: How many of the most prominent in-menu categories to keep warm per store view (max 500).

field.label: Enable Modal
field.comment: Show a trending products overlay when search returns no results.

field.label: Number of Trending Products
field.comment: How many products to fetch from OpenSearch (1–12).

field.label: Full Product Sync
field.comment: Push all products to the search platform via ingest API (background). Monitor: tail -f var/log/smartsearch-full-sync.log
